rationale: Twelve40minute lessons separate absorption/mechanisms,phloem/source evidence,planning,two actual safe environmental/structural factor investigations,rate/benefit interpretation,approved awareness sharing,audit and independent explanation. Technical preparation and actual teacher-observed performance are not inferred from supplied data.
prerequisites: Mass/time/rate units,means and simple area ratios
Safe plant/device/tool use and control reasoning
teacher_confirmation_required: Prepare safe healthy seedlings and stable sealed plastic mass potometers;approve species/sap allergies,balance/dry workspace and all teacher-only cutting.
Pilot actual10minute detectability,seals/backgrounds,replicate capacity and stabilisation;extend real opportunities if needed,record failed/not-observed evidence honestly.
Observe each learner’s named weighing/timing/record/check actions in actual environmental and structural investigations;paper/demonstration alone cannot certify outcome c.
Approve/preview digital model and record actual viewing separately;printed-only alternatives leave digital viewing not observed.
Review conditional awareness message and arrange approved class/school audience;actual broader community engagement remains separate confirmation.

No pupil ring-barking,radioisotopes,fertiliser/manure handling or site-specific dose advice;source suggested phloem experiments adapted to attributed/fictional evidence interpretation with explicit performance limit.
Confirm40minute pacing,access,role rotation,group equipment and extensions as necessary.

lesson_map.title: What can an actual root observation establish?
Do water and mineral ions enter by the same mechanism?
What supports a moving water column?
Why can a source become a sink?
Does coloured water prove sugar translocation?
What will our investigation actually measure?
How does gentle airflow affect measured water loss?
Does more leaf area imply more loss per area?
When does transpiration support or threaten plant life?
Can we share a useful,qualified plant-care message?
Which transport claims survive an audit?
